required_coverage: Every A has multiworld unobserved invariant requiring both different-fact observations plus an actual useful query after two strict nonempty filters.

A/B changes only one observation equals value, preserving table/queries/observation count/final support cardinality while usefulness changes; B all offered queries redundant with an unoffered varying fact.
C recomputes reordered prefixes and supplies an actual prefix-cardinality difference while preserving full final answers.
D supplies a repeated nonempty observation, not merely an audit-only invariance.
E supplies different-fact individually supported jointly impossible evidence; F supplies an ordinary supported later observation after empty.
Null entailed/ambiguous/empty contrasts in at least one train and one dev family; active true/int1 and false/int0 filtering/partition evidence.
All four exact/order-invariant source profiles fresh and pairwise distinct beyond arbitrary names/values; shared submotifs disclosed.
Actual per-family/context/style full role/flag/category/type/count/provenance histograms match every marginal/pair/triple bucket; annotations alone insufficient.

Every attached per-row property and locator independently witnessed; legitimate contexts can lack many tags.

Exact prior/current source/world/task lineage and whole-family split custody.
Formal oracle separate from generation; both actual independent expert/red final exact-hash reviews required before later adjudication.
Preserve disagreements and disclose prospective/guided design context, actual same identity and same-model risk.
